_this-file: One entry per destination repo, naming the WRITE REGIME that repo is published under.
'git'   an ordinary clone this workflow owns; a rejected push is integrated by merging.
'vault' a SHARED working tree other sessions also edit, of which the destination is one
subtree; a rejected push is completed from a temporary worktree created OUTSIDE
that tree, so the shared tree is never merged into, reset or swept.
The regime is deployment fact and is declared, never inferred. Branch and remote are
configuration for the same reason: the commit policy is the owner's to set.
